equalityPolicy: Direct Object.is for every returned double: matching NaNs are equal, opposite zero signs differ, all finite values and infinities must match exactly. Checksums canonicalize NaN payloads only and supplement direct comparison. Complete fixture bytes are compared and checked for mutation.

cacheAccounting.note: One lazy Float64Array(2048 * 40) per initialized candidate module, including unused column zero. Typed-array headers, existing WeakMap profile entries, allocator/GC behavior, and ESM instance retention are additional, unmeasured costs.

untimedEdgeProof.description: Complete waveform returns plus K-weight/low-pass edge calls and inactive gains. Includes NaN, infinities, empty/silent input, signed-zero input and a long fallback. Comparator explicitly rejects opposite zero signs and accepts matching NaNs.

concurrency.limitation: A cooperative lock cannot detect unrelated CPU/GPU work; the timing coordinator must arrange exclusivity.
